design: observation-only; FabricPC evidence never consulted by the router
honest_limitations: N=23 usable synthetic cases: far too small for scientific conclusions
toy routing pool and toy FabricPC graph: pipeline validation, not evidence of value
targets are frozen-router proxies (utility margin), not realized outcome labels
any apparent arm-3 gain must beat arm-4 (shuffled control) before it means anything

incremental_information.reading: lower MSE than arm1 on held-out cases would indicate incremental information; the shuffled/mismatched arm4 calibrates how much apparent improvement is attributable to extra free parameters
incremental_information.target: top-2 utility margin (deferral-need proxy from the frozen router)

latency_seconds.note: the first observation pays one-off JAX compilation; observation runs alongside routing and does not gate route selection in this tranche
